d: Actor Prakash Raj questioned the BJP-led government's contrasting positions on democracy, citing the detention of young protesters in Delhi who were holding the Tricolour and protesting to “save the Constitution”, while Union Home Minister Amit Shah held a “Save Democracy” march in Telangana. He also questioned the claims of three crore infiltrators. Raj was speaking at a press conference organised by People Against SIR in New Delhi, where he criticised the Election Commission's Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls and raised concerns over its impact on voters' rights.
